fit_reasons.text: Nearly every headline figure (customers, volume, uptime, partnerships, team size) was overstated or contradicted on first contact.
Revenue is under $30k over nine months with only ~60 active businesses, against a $10M valuation.
Company operates on partner licences with no filed IFPE application and a 12-18 month path once filed.
Technical co-founder departed and engineering now runs on an agency contractor, with a hidden instruction embedded to manipulate automated review.

tags.reason: Deck claims 400+ customers, 99.99% uptime, Visa partnership and 12-person team, all materially narrowed by calls and public data.
Website contained a hidden instruction targeting AI reviewers to bias the assessment, plus a cited third-party rating and a rushed deadline.
Monthly traction series, cap table, partner agreements, Stripe standing and financials are all missing before a partner meeting.

dropped.reason: Revenue is near-negligible (~$3.3k/month) compared to activity claims, closer to pilot-stage than real traction.
dropped.why: the statements it cites show revenue
